_comment: progression-shop: the Skill Shop (Eric's playtest-2 ruling). Replaces level-up skill offers; the free opening role pick at the start stays. Prices are in mob values (LootTables.json economy), so they follow the gold players have. Edit live in F8 > Economy. See Docs/Progression.md.

readyGate._comment: Skill Shop mode: the next wave waits until every human presses READY TO CONTINUE (bots auto-ready); maxSeconds is the AFK safety cap (0 = none), counted down on screen in its last 30 s. Edit live in F8 > Economy.

scaling._comment: Per skill level (no cap): damage/healing +effectPerLevel, mana/energy cost +costPerLevel, cooldown x (1 - cooldownPerLevel) down to minCooldownFactor.

slots._comment: The 6 active + 1 passive + 1 ultimate structure stays; slots open over the match.

bots._comment: Bots spend on skills first while a slot is open, then level their lowest-ranked skill, then items.
